decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's established offer, likely draws on patented or improved formulation work, and is shown on its own page, so the investment and visible commitment favor keeping it after only one year on the market.

The generic antidepressant capsule is distant from the core offer and probably cost less to develop, making it the most exposed product, but it was launched only in 2024, is presented on its own page, and any weak early results can still be blamed on start-up effects.
The combination antihypertensive is close to the firm's core, publicly presented on its own page, and fits the announced direction of improved formulations, so management would persist with it.

The supplement is only mentioned on the website and needed little investment, but it fits the stated strategy of building pharmacy-exclusive health products to reduce dependence on reimbursement, and one year is too short to rule out temporary causes for weak results.
